author: CNET
description:
Apple’s new HomeView isn’t new. But what makes the HomeView compelling is that it’s Apple’s first device designed specifically for AppleMs HomeKit ecosystem, and it also lets you manage calendars, grocery lists and more. 

The design feels premium right out of the box, with a tiltable 4:3 screen, a speaker grille along the bottom, and a soft non-slip white bottom. Unbox the $299 HomeView with us. #apple #unboxing #homeview #smarthome #smartdisplays
title: Unboxing Apple’s $299 HomeView Smart Home Hub
